title: Meridian Solar Annual Report 2024
text: Meridian Solar Annual Report 2024. Overview of operations and financial results for the fiscal year. Generation. In 2024 Meridian Solar generated 480 gigawatt-hours of electricity from its Northfield and Helios arrays, up from 455 gigawatt-hours in 2023. Capacity. Nameplate capacity reached 312 megawatts at year end. The company operates 14 utility-scale sites across the region. Employees. As of December 2024 the company employed 84 full-time staff. Financing. Series B financing closed at 22 million dollars in November 2024. Research partnerships. Meridian Solar maintains a research partnership with Helios Analytics on forecast accuracy. The report contains no statement about government subsidies, carbon offset purchases, or a pilot programme in Indonesia.

title: Helios Analytics: Meridian Solar Series B Brief
text: Helios Analytics research brief. Series B financing. Meridian Solar closed its Series B at 22 million dollars in November 2024, led by Northfield Ventures with participation from two existing investors. The round values the company at 110 million dollars post-money. Market position. Meridian Solar holds an estimated 19 percent share of the regional utility-scale segment. The brief does not discuss generation volumes, employee counts, or any pilot programme in Indonesia.

title: Northland Utilities Interconnection Log
text: Northland Utilities interconnection log for Q4 2024. Meridian Solar Helios Array 2 was interconnected to the Northland grid on 14 October 2024 with a contracted capacity of 48 megawatts. Meridian Solar Northfield Array was interconnected on 2 September 2024 with a contracted capacity of 36 megawatts. No other Meridian Solar sites were interconnected during the quarter. The log records no interconnection in Portugal and no battery storage commissioning.

title: Meridian Solar Sustainability Note 2024
text: Meridian Solar Sustainability Note 2024. The company reports scope 1 and 2 emissions of 1,140 tonnes of CO2 equivalent for the calendar year. Offsets. The company purchased 1,140 tonnes of verified carbon offsets, matching its measured footprint. Water use. Operational water use was 9,200 cubic metres. The note does not mention a 40 percent carbon intensity reduction target.
